reasoning: On the season so far the Cavaliers are the stronger team; with home court the Cavaliers start about 10 points better, in a game of about 245 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Cavaliers win 76 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 219 and 267 total points.
